top_news.title: Chicago Cubs Takes 2-12 Win
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs beat Pittsburgh Pirates 2-12. Alex Bregman: 3 H, 1 HR, 2 RBI, 4 AB Shota Imanaga: 6.0 IP, 4 K, 2 ER, 2 BB, 5 H Pete Crow-Armstrong singles on a line drive to right fielder Jared Triolo. Pedro Ramírez scores. Carson Kelly to 2nd.

top_news.title: Detroit Tigers Takes 2-6 Win
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers beat Colorado Rockies 2-6. Dillon Dingler: 1 H, 1 HR, 2 RBI, 4 AB Mason Adams: 5.0 IP, 5 K, 1 ER, 3 BB, 2 H Zac Veen singles on a soft ground ball to pitcher Brant Hurter. Adael Amador scores.

top_news.title: Washington Nationals Takes 3-4 Win
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals beat Los Angeles Angels 3-4. Mike Trout: 1 H, 1 HR, 1 RBI, 3 AB Cade Cavalli: 6.0 IP, 9 K, 2 ER, 2 BB, 3 H Christian Moore doubles (3) on a sharp fly ball to center fielder Dylan Crews. Oswald Peraza scores.

top_news.title: New York Yankees Takes 4-6 Win
top_news.summary: New York Yankees beat New York Mets 4-6. Cody Bellinger: 2 H, 1 HR, 3 RBI, 4 AB Carlos Rodón: 6.1 IP, 8 K, 1 ER, 1 BB, 3 H A.J. Ewing homers (9) on a fly ball to right field.
